title: Address Verification
description: Paste a batch of tracking numbers; the system fetches iMile sorting coordinates and reverse-looks-up the postcode against official ABS postal area boundaries to check whether it matches the system's zip code. For addresses resolved to postcode 5000 (Adelaide City), it also flags Australia Post office/PO Box addresses that cannot be delivered.
inputPlaceholder: Paste tracking numbers, separated by line breaks / commas / spaces
